ben: Seeing steady growth in Pending small-gpu pods in ap-southeast1c since 06:30 UTC.
kai: Any common failure reasons?
ben: Scheduler says: 0/24 nodes available: 10 nodes tainted {gpu-thermal:true}, 14 nodes failed affinity/anti-affinity.
diane: That thermal taint is expected during the heat window but it causes fragmentation when combined with strict rack affinity for tiny pods.
maria: Ops bot should auto-untaint after cooling window, but holes remain. We need a quick mitigation.
kai: Proposal: 1) relax job-family affinity to preferredDuringScheduling with weight 50 for CI/test pods; 2) enable compacting heuristic behind a toggle; 3) bump dedicated pool by 2 GPUs for 3h if backlog persists.
ben: Short-term do (1) + autoscaler headroom bump. Diane/ops: can you add an alert for pending_small_pods>=5 && headroom_pct>=30?
diane: On it. Will also create a scheduler toggle canary in ap-southeast1c/apse1b.
ops-bot: [system] Auto-untaint job scheduled for 10 nodes in ap-southeast1c. Alert rule created: ap-southeast1c_tiny_pod_fragmentation.
maria: Opening PR to relax affinity on job-x: https://git.company/repo/infra/PR-782. Rolling 10% now.
ben: Monitor eviction churn and pending counts for 1h after roll. If nothing improves, we'll request temporary capacity increase.
